title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:08852:20080229:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 8852, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That ... <omitted> ... where provisions of Acts amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda amend Acts that had been promulgated before this Act entered into force but whose enforcement dates had not yet arrived, each such amendment shall enter into force on the enforcement date of the corresponding Act.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Acts) (1) through (676) Omitted.

(677) The Act on the Fostering of the Korea Sea Explorers Association is partially amended as follows:

In Articles 6 through 10, "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries" shall be replaced with "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs".

(678) through (760) Omitted.

Article 7 Omitted.
